sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
FINANCE ACT, 1964 (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An Act to amend the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964, in
its appli cation to the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1(40)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Finance Act,
1964 (North-West Frontier Province Amend ment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 12 of W. P. Act No. XXXIV of 1964

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
FINANCE ACT, 1964 (NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An Act to amend the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964, in
its appli cation to the North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1(40)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province,
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province, on
the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 12 of
W. P. Act No. XXXIV of 1964.--In the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964 (W. P.
Act No. XXXIV of 1964), in its application to the North-West Frontier Province,
in section 12, after sub section (4), the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:-
"(5) Government may, under
special circumstances, remit the whole or part of the cess collected in the
manner aforesaid.".
